name: Herman Padel Center
description: Herman Padel Center brings four indoor courts to Ggaba Road in Nsambya, Kampala, with published phone and email. A clear recommendation when you want a named Uganda padel destination with long daily hours. Confirm booking channels on the club site before peak slots.

name: Smash Padel Uganda
description: Smash Padel Uganda is a Bukoto padel club on Old Kira Road with Playtomic booking, two covered courts, and published phone. A strong recommendation for Kampala players who want bookable padel with café and restaurant on site. Book ahead for late evening sessions.
